rules.title: Run tasks through turbo
rules.text: Run build, test and lint through turbo so results are cached and ordered by the task graph.

rules.title: Declare dependsOn
rules.text: Declare dependsOn with ^task for tasks that need dependency packages built first.

rules.title: List task outputs
rules.text: List outputs for every cacheable task so a cache hit restores its artifacts.

rules.title: Declare env that changes output
rules.text: Declare environment variables that change a task result in env, or in globalEnv for all tasks, so cache keys change with them.

rules.title: Narrow inputs
rules.text: Narrow task inputs so unrelated file changes do not cause cache misses.

rules.title: Filter runs
rules.text: Use turbo run <task> --filter=<package> to limit work to the packages you touched and their dependents.

rules.title: Persistent dev tasks
rules.text: Mark dev and watch tasks persistent and not cached.

rules.title: No root-script bypass
rules.text: Put tasks in packages and register them in turbo.json rather than in root scripts that bypass the graph.
